name: Wholesale Medical Devices
old_description: Professional-grade orthopedic support used by top physicians at wholesale prices
about:
Wholesale Medical Devices operates from Apex, North Carolina. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure, and no founders are named in public materials.

The company supplies orthopedic support products including braces for the wrist, hand, arm, shoulder, foot, ankle, knee, back, and neck, as well as cryotherapy, TENS, and garment lines. It states that all items use FDA-approved, medical-grade materials and offers a catalog of 250-plus SKUs. Pricing is tiered, with discounts beginning at 10 units and scaling with order volume. Standard orders ship in five to seven business days; high-volume partners receive same-day shipping. A 30-day return policy applies.

Customers include hospitals, clinics, nursing homes, rehabilitation centers, medical practices, and licensed professionals, as well as businesses that stock clinical devices for resale or internal use. The company also serves athletes and physicians, citing testimonials from a basketball player, a prescribing physician, and a chronic-pain patient.

Wholesale Medical Devices says its mission is to deliver premium medical products at the most competitive prices without compromising performance, safety, or value. It emphasizes direct-from-manufacturer pricing with no distributor markup, U.S.-based support, and a partnership approach that treats buyers as partners rather than account numbers.
